packageRules.description: Operator-stack pins still owned by this repo: the cloudflared image (roles/cloudflare_tunnel) and the restic binary (roles/backup). Bumps stay manual -- either can break the platform out-of-band -- and the Trivy job gates the PR on CVEs. NOT grouped: one PR per pin, so a CVE in one cannot hold the other's update hostage; a grouped cloudflared+traefik PR went red on a cloudflared-only CVE and blocked the traefik bump with it. traefik, postgres, portainer and coturn left this repo on 2026-08-03: their specs, and so their image pins, live in the catena-admin tier-1 catalog, tracked by that repo's Renovate.

Infra app images pinned in role defaults (gatus, healthchecks, recovery nginx, clamav). Manual review like the operator-stack pins; Trivy gates each PR. NOT grouped: one PR per image, same rationale as the operator-stack pins -- one image's CVE must not hold the others' updates hostage.
Beszel hub + agent stay ONE PR: the agent pin is kept in lockstep with the hub (same upstream release), so splitting them would merge a hub bump without its matching agent.

Keycloak (Phase Two distribution) image pinned in the keycloak role defaults. Manual review like the other infra pins -- a Keycloak major/minor can break SSO + the oauth2-proxy wiring out-of-band; Trivy gates the PR. Restricted to the rolling X.Y.Z tag; the timestamped X.Y.Z.<unixtime> immutable builds are excluded.
